description: This file defines the TimestampShape class, which represents a timestamp data type in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes functionality to format timestamp values into different string representations based on specified formats.

classes.name: TimestampShape
classes.description: Represents a timestamp shape used in AWS API definitions, providing methods to format timestamp values according to different serialization formats.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a TimestampShape instance, setting the shape type to 'timestamp' and initializing via the parent constructor.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a timestamp value for a service based on the specified format ('iso8601', 'rfc822', 'unixTimestamp').
